name: Quiz show
brief: A TV quiz: the question on a big glowing panel, answer options as 2–4 chunky buttons (A/B/C/D) stacked in the middle, a huge 3-2-1 countdown with a ticking ring during the guess scene, then the right button lights green and the wrong ones dim and shake, with a confetti burst. Saturated studio colours (deep purple or blue with gold), bold rounded type; the explanation scenes stay in the same set.
